# Strasbourg Walk

> An independent, fact-checked guide to visiting Strasbourg (Alsace, France), published by TouringBee.
> Every price, opening time and date is verified against the official source for the current year.

## Key verified facts (checked July 2026)

- Strasbourg Cathedral nave: free entry. Mon-Sat 08:30-11:15 and 12:45-17:45; Sun 14:00-17:15.
- Astronomical clock: show at 12:30, entry from 11:30 at the Saint-Michel door, EUR 3 adult / EUR 2 reduced. Tickets are sold same-day on site only. No online booking exists.
- Cathedral platform: 330 steps to 66 m. EUR 10 adult / EUR 6 reduced. Apr-Sep 09:30-20:00, Oct-Mar 10:00-18:00. On-site sale only; no skip-the-line ticket exists.
- Batorama boat tour (Circuit Rouge): 1 h 10, EUR 16.20 adult. In 2026 board at pontoon A by the cathedral; pontoons B and C are out of service.
- Strasbourg municipal museums: EUR 7.50 each, 1-day pass EUR 16, 3-day pass EUR 20. Free the first Sunday of every month. Closed Mondays.
- Musee Alsacien is closed for renovation until 1 June 2028.
- European Parliament visits are free; a physical passport or national ID card is mandatory.
- Strasbourg City Card: EUR 5 for 7 days. It is a discount card, not an inclusive pass.
- Paris Gare de l'Est to Strasbourg: 19 trains per day, fastest 1 h 45, fares from about EUR 32.
- Christmas market (Christkindelsmaerik), running since 1570: the 2026 dates were not yet published as of July 2026.

## Product

- [Strasbourg Self-Guided Audio Tour](https://touringbee.com/product/city-tour-of-strasbourg/): 33 stops, about 2.5 hours, from the train station through Petite France and the Barrage Vauban to the cathedral. Works fully offline. Eight languages. From EUR 9.99, one payment, one year of access. The offline GPS map shows your position; the visitor starts each audio track manually at the stop.
